role: Independent review of parent runner; author of GP and selection modules, whose mathematical/source review is separately independent in literature/v6_methods

checks.nested_source_exclusion: Every inner population/reference/planner training fold removes both outer and validation source families, including small/ineligible linked conditions. Outer fits remove the whole outer family. Training-only Cui family is retained.
checks.cache_identity: Cache directory binds freeze digest, sorted full family exclusions and exact ordered training CSV. Unordered pair reuse is valid in both validation directions.
checks.reference_statistics: GP raw mean coefficients, sigma and tau are read from the hierarchy fitted on that precise training fold; no target statistics. Student standardization/knots are fitted from training frame only.
checks.score_aggregation: Direct independent nested arithmetic confirms query mean then equal k0/k3, seed, condition within family, and 11-family mean. All expected episode keys and finite availability required.
checks.candidate_selection: 146 unique candidates: GP66, Student48, control22, joint RFL10. Inner-only finite logscore and fixed 1e-6/ordinal tie rule. Missing inner episode disqualifies candidate for relevant outer direction.
checks.common_episodes: One per-task policy ledger is computed before iterating predictors; all aliases/candidates use identical queries and selected revealed support observations. Quantile API is covariate-only; outcomes enter separate scoring API.
checks.numerical_eligibility: Finite-quantile CDF values must have matching shape, be finite/in range and satisfy q10 discrepancy<=1e-3. NaN quantile/nonfinite outer score is explicit unavailable, with no alternative predictor selected.
checks.numerical_evidence: Inner target receipts retained in deterministic compressed sidecars and hashed before selection; outer distinct quantile/scoring/CDF-check receipts retain joint evidence-ratio quadrature diagnostics.
checks.frozen_inner_decision: Outer verifies selected score table and all inner CSV hashes, recomputes winning candidate under frozen rule, binds selected.json bytes into every shard and combine guard.
checks.cost: Primary1e6 support cap identifies recorded capped costs because all censor stops>=cap.1e7 sensitivity retains censor lower/upper intervals. Fixed-k has no unrecorded cost stopping.
checks.design_scope: 37 eligible conditions/396 rows/12 source families.370 outer tasks,111 inner templates,66 pair-exclusion trainsets. Source families and working conditions do not certify physical builds.

synthetic_tests.scope: generated families, manufactured mock log scores, real orchestration/aggregation only

covariate_only_secondary_subset.rule: pool_n>k and pool logstress span>=.05 decades

limitations: No fatigue fits or real outcome comparisons performed by this audit. Final runtime/source freeze remains parent responsibility.
GP and Student unit-factor population objectives differ from legacy source-balanced composite controls; architecture or dimensionality mechanism is not isolated.
All historical outcomes were seen; nested separation is exploratory reused-data evaluation, not prospective confirmation.
Predictive q10 is not R90C90 and no change in actual specimen life is implied.
Outer stress monotonicity diagnostic is at observed query stress values, not a global proof.
Remaining nonlinear/joint quadrature numerical validation is separate from the runner orchestration audit.
